# `insert_final_newline`

Ensure the file ends with a newline.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

## Effect

`true` ends the file with a newline, adding one if it's missing. `false` removes the newline after the last line. A code block can't show the difference. With the key unset Curb behaves as `true`, while `dotnet format` leaves the end of the file as it is ([#262](https://github.com/nullean/curb/issues/262)).
